<div class="enthusia-wiki">
<p>When enabled, players join an event, receive event-specific equipment/state, play the selected game, then return to their normal SMP state afterward.</p>
<h2>Implemented event types</h2>
<details class="enthusia-drop drop"><summary><b>Combat & elimination</b><span>SkyWars, BedWars, fights, sumo and more</span></summary><div><table class="wikitable enthusia-table"><thead><tr><th>Event</th><th>How to play</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><b>SkyWars</b></td><td>Loot your island/mid and eliminate everyone else. Last player alive wins.</td></tr><tr><td><b>BedWars</b></td><td>Protect your bed, collect generator resources, buy items/upgrades and destroy enemy beds. <strong>BedWars uses 1.8-style PvP.</strong></td></tr><tr><td><b>Fight 1v1</b></td><td>Direct/bracket combat; beat your opponent to advance or win.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Fight 2v2</b></td><td>Two-player teams fight until one team is eliminated. Implemented but not currently planned as an enabled selection.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Fight FFA</b></td><td>Every player for themselves; last survivor wins.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Sumo 1v1</b></td><td>Knock your opponent off the platform first.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Sumo 2v2</b></td><td>Team sumo; knock out the opposing team. Implemented but not currently planned as an enabled selection.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Sumo FFA</b></td><td>Free-for-all sumo; stay on the platform while eliminating everyone else.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Knockback FFA</b></td><td>Knockback-focused free-for-all elimination.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Quake</b></td><td>Fast railgun-style combat; score hits/kills with the event weapon.</td></tr><tr><td><b>One in the Chamber</b></td><td>Projectile combat with limited shots and continuing respawns/score.</td></tr></tbody></table></div></details>
<details class="enthusia-drop drop"><summary><b>Team objectives</b><span>capture games</span></summary><div><table class="wikitable enthusia-table"><thead><tr><th>Event</th><th>How to play</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><b>Capture the Flag</b></td><td>Take the enemy flag and return it while protecting your own. The implemented target is three captures.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Capture Players</b></td><td>Capture/carry enemy players into your jail area while rescuing teammates.</td></tr></tbody></table></div></details>
<details class="enthusia-drop drop"><summary><b>Party & survival</b><span>block party, hot potato, spleef and more</span></summary><div><table class="wikitable enthusia-table"><thead><tr><th>Event</th><th>How to play</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><b>Block Party</b></td><td>Move onto the announced concrete color before the other colors disappear.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Hot Potato</b></td><td>Pass the potato before its timer eliminates you.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Spleef</b></td><td>Break the floor under other players without falling yourself.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Splegg</b></td><td>Projectile Spleef: shoot floor blocks to make other players fall.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Red Light Green Light</b></td><td>Move on green, stop on red, and reach the finish without being caught moving.</td></tr></tbody></table></div></details>
<details class="enthusia-drop drop"><summary><b>Races & completion</b><span>boat, horse, Elytra and parkour</span></summary><div><table class="wikitable enthusia-table"><thead><tr><th>Event</th><th>How to play</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td><b>Boat Race</b></td><td>Race the boat course and finish first.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Horse Race</b></td><td>Race the configured course on horseback.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Elytra Race</b></td><td>Fly through required rings/checkpoints in order and finish first.</td></tr><tr><td><b>Parkour</b></td><td>Complete the course/checkpoints in order; finish placement decides the result.</td></tr></tbody></table></div></details>
<h2>Commands when Events returns</h2><details class="enthusia-drop drop"><summary><b>Event commands</b><span>open list</span></summary><div><table class="wikitable enthusia-table"><tbody><tr><td><code>/event</code></td><td>Show the event/status.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/event join</code> / <code>leave</code></td><td>Join or leave the current event.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/event spectate</code></td><td>Spectate where supported.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/event vote</code></td><td>Open event voting.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/event start</code></td><td>Open/select player-startable events where permitted.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/event stats</code></td><td>Open event statistics.</td></tr><tr><td><code>/event next</code></td><td>Show the next scheduled event-vote time when scheduling is enabled.</td></tr></tbody></table></div></details>
<h2>KOTH</h2><p>KOTH is a separate system and is currently disabled.</p>
</div>
